prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A married couple aged 45 and 43 celebrate their silver wedding anniversary in a modest garden, holding hands and smiling while a few adult friends congratulate them nearby. They wear simple light linen clothing, with a small flower arrangement nearby. Use a natural environmental photograph and soft golden evening light without printed anniversary numbers. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The 45-year-old husband has short salt-and-pepper hair, a clean-shaven broad face and rectangular glasses. The 43-year-old wife has shoulder-length auburn waves, a slightly square face, and no glasses. The two adult friends in background are a dark-haired woman and a bald clean-shaven man, visibly different. Exact horizontal 16:9. Photograph a genuinely wide environmental garden view with the main couple, joined hands, and any important gestures inside central 55 percent of width; generous garden at both edges.
review: Reviewed wide anniversary garden image: salt-and-pepper-haired man with glasses holds hands with auburn-haired wife; two distinct adults clap behind them. Joined hands and visible fingers are coherent, main couple safely within central crop; warm garden light, restrained flowers, no lettering.
